description_en: Supports automatic localization and recognition of key fields on both the front and back pages of a vehicle registration certificate. It also supports automatic segmentation and structured recognition when both pages appear in the same image
description_zh: 支持对行驶证正页、副页关键字段的自动定位和识别，同时也支持对正副页在同一张图片的场景进行自动分割与结构化识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-vehicle-license --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/bzyhho/%E8%A1%8C%E9%A9%B6%E8%AF%81%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeVehicleLicense

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
